description: Swimmer Stock Trading discovers Solana stock-token routes, checks balances, and submits custodial market or limit orders through https://swimmer.finance. It uses a fixed recipient, trusted mint allowlists, spending caps, simulation, and optional fast mode for immediate, confirmation-free submission.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
